hero.sub: Full-cycle international logistics from Ukraine to Europe and beyond. Road, air, sea, rail, customs and warehousing — in one system.

svc.title: Six modes. One team.
svc.sub: Every mode is run by a dedicated dispatch center with its own insurance and SLA.

auto.d: Own fleet and vetted partners across Ukraine — EU — Asia. Tilts, reefers, oversized cargo.

air.d: Urgent shipments worldwide in 2–5 days. Project charters on demand.

sea.d: FCL and LCL container shipments. Direct contracts with leading ocean carriers. Booking and tracking in one dashboard.

rail.d: Container trains Europe — China. Platforms, wagons, leasing.

cust.d: Own customs representations across Europe. Brokerage, classification, permits.

wh.d: Own class A/B warehouses in Ukraine and the EU. Storage, cross-docking, fulfilment.

calc.title: Get a price in 30 seconds.
calc.sub: Enter your shipment parameters — receive a preliminary cost breakdown and ETA instantly.

off.title: 7 own offices. 20+ partner countries.
off.sub: Own transport, warehouses and customs representations across Europe. Partner offices on key global routes.
off.partners_s: Direct agency agreements on all key trade lanes

routes.title: A single network from Kyiv to Shanghai.
routes.sub: Own offices and partner hubs on every key lane. We see your cargo on every leg.

proc.title: Four steps — and your cargo is on the road.

s1.d: Send shipment details. Get a rate and a draft route within 30 minutes.

s2.d: We sign the contract and insure the cargo. A dedicated manager is assigned.

s3.d: Track from your dashboard. Get notified at every milestone.

s4.d: Customs, unloading, documents. Close the deal in one click.

contact.title: Ready to ship?
contact.sub: Leave a request — a dedicated manager will reach out within 30 minutes with a tailored offer.
